_note: Corrections to Cliopatria itself, applied as the file is read, before anything else. 'clip' removes the ground of one polity ('by') from another's shapes over a span of years, splitting a shape at the ends of the span. 'rename' gives a polity a new name from a year, splitting its rows there; the renamed rows become a polity of their own, continuing the same line. Every entry says why.

clip.why: Cliopatria's 1961-2023 shape for France still includes Algeria; Algeria became independent in 1962 and has its own rows from 1963, so the two overlapped for sixty years.
